title: Customers receiving wrong or damaged items
situation: High volume of complaints about receiving incorrect or damaged items requires immediate triage to prevent escalation.

params.reply_en: We are sorry you received the wrong or damaged item. We will arrange a replacement or refund immediately. Please check your email for next steps.

actions.why: Acknowledge issue and set expectation for resolution.

params.note: Investigate transit damage and potential mis-shipments for recent orders.
